boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 63 crams the board with oversized LEGO blocks — L-shapes, tall rectangles, and large squares — all interlocked with counter numbers up to 11. The opening strategy is an edge-peel: extract green blocks from the upper-right and the yellow '11' block from the upper-left. Once the edges thin, the interlocked center (red square, blue L-shape, purple blocks) can finally be separated. The blue L-piece on the right side needs the most clearance and usually leaves last.
landmarks: Block Out Level 63 crams the board with oversized LEGO blocks — L-shapes, tall rectangles, and large squares — all interlocked with counter numbers up to 11.
The opening strategy is an edge-peel: extract green blocks from the upper-right and the yellow '11' block from the upper-left.
Once the edges thin, the interlocked center (red square, blue L-shape, purple blocks) can finally be separated.
The blue L-piece on the right side needs the most clearance and usually leaves last.

quickTips: Always thin the edges before touching the center — one wrong center move locks the board.
The blue L-shaped piece on the right side needs the most clearance and should leave late.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Pull the green blocks from the upper-right through the top exit.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the yellow '11' block leftward toward its exit to free the upper-left.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Shift the orange blocks on the left edge down once the upper corner opens.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Extract the red square from the center-left once enough edge space exists.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Route the blue L-shape on the right side out — it needs the most clearance.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining purple and cyan blocks once the center is open.

failurePoints: Moving a center block before the edges are thinned — the interlocked pieces jam instantly.
Trying to extract the blue L-shape early when there is not enough vertical and horizontal room.
